scope: Authentic production assets copied into video/assets for the Metralign technical film. This registry records identity, scientific-evidence, and official event marks; presence here does not enlarge any scientific claim.
asset_policy: No generative-image system, stock-illustration pack, synthetic icon set, or decorative pseudo-chart was used.
Scientific imagery is either byte-identical project evidence or a byte-identical copy of a source-bound project plate.
Third-party marks come only from the official SEMICON India Hackathon 2026 page and remain outside the repository MIT license.
Third-party marks must remain secondary to Metralign, unaltered, and limited to truthful event-role identification.

event_record.note: The film may identify the official event and the Drift-Sense industry partner. It must not state or visually imply that SEMI or Applied Materials endorses Metralign.

excluded_candidates.reason: Composite Applied Materials and KLA partner strip. KLA belongs to the other track; using the strip would imply irrelevant co-branding.
Composite industry-partner lockup includes KLA and creates an unnecessary logo wall.
Generic event-page stock photographs and decorative icons were excluded because their licensing and evidentiary relevance are not established.
Corporate b-roll was not needed to explain Metralign and would add licensing weight plus a risk of implied endorsement.
